name: keg-craft-discovery
purpose: Observe implicit craft discovery with every source from a keg path (candidate-keg-k238). A Grove impl leaf asks for a small command-line tool that agents run, and names no skill. Ravel captures Grove's six sources from the candidate keg that task owner:candidate-keg built from the prepared commit, at share/ravel/skills/<id>. No source comes from a checkout, and no native copy exists. Expect a read of craft/cli-tool-design/SKILL.md from the design snapshot before the tool is written, and each resourceDigest equal to the keg's accepted digest.
